metadata.scope: primitive-support main-scale effect: pre-primitive m1 -> primitive pure-G

definitions.M_q: pre-primitive G-neutral/m1 category mass before gcd(x,y,z)=1
definitions.G_q: primitive pure-G category mass from Stage13-7j

preprimitive_outer_shell_count.all_dilates: S_f(B)=(2/pi^2)*(int f)*B log B + O_f(B) before face-support exclusion
preprimitive_outer_shell_count.face_support_exclusion: G(p)=1 iff p has no q=1 mod 4 prime. The no-split semigroup has count O(X/sqrt(log X)), hence excluded shells O(B sqrt(log B)).

inner_angle_remainder.decomposition: zero kernel k_q(t) plus centered Gaussian harmonics (H_l(p)-1)/(G(p)-1)
inner_angle_remainder.bound: The Stage13-7i/j finite Vaaler truncation and nontrivial Gaussian-Hecke input give o(B log B), which is all 7ja requires.
inner_angle_remainder.role: only the zero angular mode contributes to the B log B main term

primitive_correction.theorem: P_q(B) ~ -C_q B log B for each q
primitive_correction.interpretation: primitive support cancels the entire pre-primitive B log B main scale; it is not a lower-order perturbation

normalized_direction.conclusion: primitive support changes absolute logarithmic scale but not the leading normalized directional vector
